videos.title: Radio Propagation 101
videos.relevance: This is a focused overview of propagation modes and band behavior, which directly supports the page's discussion of ground wave, skywave, and line-of-sight travel.

videos.title: All Modulation Types Explained in 3 Minutes
videos.relevance: This short video gives Scouts a quick visual introduction to modulation, reinforcing the page's explanation of how information rides on a carrier wave.

videos.title: How to Read a Schematic
videos.relevance: Requirement 5 starts by comparing block diagrams and schematics, and this video gives a concrete visual example of what a schematic looks like and how to follow it.
videos.query: Radio Requirement 5a: Block Diagrams vs. Schematics

videos.title: FRS VS GMRS: A Radio Service Comparison Guide
videos.relevance: This directly compares the services covered in Req 8e1 and helps Scouts hear the practical differences between FRS and GMRS before comparing them to CB and amateur radio.

videos.title: Why Some AM Radio Stations Don't Work at Night
videos.relevance: This is tightly aligned with the requirement's day-versus-night AM listening question and gives a memorable explanation of why nighttime propagation changes what you hear.
videos.query: Radio The Science of Nighttime AM

videos.title: Tape Measure Yagi Beam Antenna - Ham Radio Q&A
videos.relevance: This is a direct match for the Scout-friendly tape-measure Yagi build described on the page, so it supports the exact antenna project used for ARDF.
